name: Martinique
summary_text: Martinique: full French law applies; modest visible scene in Fort-de-France; traditional norms persist. Scored as a dependent jurisdiction: the parent framework governs what a visitor encounters, plus local society and enforcement. Score re-anchored 2026-09-24: France (0.67) plus a local delta of -0.05. This jurisdiction was not covered by the dedicated state/province research passes.

sources.title: The Plight Of Trans Women In Prison
sources.claim_summary: BuzzFeed News feature (Jan 2018, French context): trans women in France incarcerated on the basis of their legal gender fall into a legal gray area - relevant to Martinique as a French overseas region applying French law.

CGLPL opinion of 25 May 2021 on the treatment of transgender persons in places of deprivation of liberty (French context, applicable in Martinique): serious violations persist across places of detention.

sources.title: Martinique LGBTQI+ Resources – Rights in Exile
sources.claim_summary: Rights in Exile (AsyLex) Martinique LGBTQI+ resources: same-sex marriage and full French anti-discrimination protections apply (decriminalisation 1815; Article 73 of the Constitution extends French law); public attitudes, state protection capacity, case law, supporting organisations and country-of-origin experts.

sources.claim_summary: JM Concept 972 (in French): the lesbian, gay, bi and trans network in Martinique - organises private parties and garden parties, provides information, meeting and services for the LGBT community including gay-friendly heterosexual supporters.
